assets.label: workshop hoists and press
assets.service: heavy vehicle component removal and pressing

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: certification and identification of anchor points
exclusion of people from beneath elevated work

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: vendor notification - premature wear on LIFT-CLASS-W

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ANCHOR_POINT_CERTIFICATION: the certification and identification of anchor points was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control DROP_ZONE_EXCLUSION: the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the certification and identification of anchor points on HO-9403 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in providing fall protection, specifically selecting and inspecting fall-arrest equipment. HO-9403 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the certification and identification of anchor points was not in place. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 2 April 2018 the original equipment manufacturer issued an advisory affecting HO-9403 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop.
